original_value: This article explores a hybrid framework that combines certificateless deniable authentication with skin-inspired wearable sensing for secure e-voting and human–machine interaction. The proposed system emphasizes flexible interfaces, lightweight cryptographic protocol design, tamper-resistant data capture, and real-time verification for portable intelligent devices. Potential applications include healthcare-grade identity confirmation, assistive voting terminals, and secure tactile input platforms.
